Package com.hiface.sdk.search

Interface FaceSearchListener

public interface FaceSearchListener
Search listener. All callbacks are delivered asynchronously on the main thread.

  • Method Details

    • onFrame

      void onFrame(@NonNull FaceSearchFrame frame)
      Deliver complete samples in frame order. A recently completed scored frame may arrive before a newer detection-only frame. A null score in a detection-only frame does not mean a failed match; identities are not copied across frames. Use this callback to refresh the display and use the final onResult outcome for application actions.

    • onProgress

      void onProgress(@NonNull FaceSearchProgress progress)
      Deliver guidance when the stage or face count changes. Search does not publish a separate liveness-detection stage.

    • onResult

      void onResult(@NonNull FaceSearchResult result)
      Delivers the final result of a search round. Check the end reason first, then read the identity, similarity, and liveness score from that sample.

    • onError

      void onError(@NonNull HiFaceError error)
      Processing errors are delivered separately from business outcomes such as no match or failed liveness. Opening, preparation, or search errors pause the session and can be retried with resume. A session rejected because the SDK is closed or another camera flow is active must be recreated after fixing the cause; resume cannot activate it.
